biotools.summary: A fast, offline, pathogen-agnostic toolkit for lineage classification and marker-driven genotyping from whole-genome sequencing data. Bring your own SNP marker panel for any microbial pathogen — pathotypr handles the rest. Ships with curated panels for Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex (MTBC): 3,707 lineage-defining SNPs and over 102,000 resistance-associated mutations. Works with assembled genomes (FASTA) and raw reads (FASTQ). Available as command-line interface and cross-platform desktop GUI (Tauri).
